notes: Radon dataset (obs cols u,x,y,radon,county; identical to radon.data.json). Own Stan y_x.stan is complete-pooling lm(y~x), but the Gelman & Hill (2007) radon example fits the hierarchical model (ARM Ch.12); filed as such per the radon-reappears rule. y is log radon, raw radon ignored. Read the README and y_x.stan.
ARM Ch.12 varying-intercept radon (README radon_no_pool: lmer(y ~ x + (1 | county))); no own radon.stan. Gelman & Hill (2007). y is log radon, raw radon ignored. Read README.

Radon dataset with county present. Own Stan radon_complete_pool.stan is the complete-pooling baseline lm(y~x); the dataset's documented ARM Ch.12 hierarchical fit (y ~ x + (1 | county)) is filed here per the radon-reappears rule. y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_group.stan (ARM Ch.12): varying county intercept with county-level uranium predictor u. Read the Stan code and README. y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_group_chr.stan: non-centered (Matt-trick) reparameterisation of radon_group, same model (ARM Ch.12). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_intercept.stan (ARM Ch.12): varying-intercept-only radon model. x and u present but unused by this model (kept as columns). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_intercept_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of radon_intercept, same model (ARM Ch.12). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_no_pool.stan (ARM Ch.12): despite the name it fits the partial-pooling varying-intercept model with floor x (a ~ normal(mu_a, sigma_a)). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_no_pool_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of radon_no_pool, same model (ARM Ch.12). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.

Full national radon survey (Gelman & Hill 2007 source of the radon example); ARM fits the Minnesota subset (radon.data.json) with the county varying-intercept model, applied here to the national table. activity is the raw radon measurement (pCi/L); floor is the floor indicator. RULE GAP: county names recur across states nationally, so the unambiguous grouping unit is state:county (the book's single-state model uses county alone). Ignored: row id, survey weight adjwt, duplicate state code, zip, flags and alternate fips codes. Read README.

ARM Ch.13 earnings varying-slope model (README earnings_vary_si: lmer(log(earn) ~ 1 + (1 + height | eth))); no own earnings.stan. A further documented model (earnings_latin_square, grouping eth, age, eth:age) is carried by that object. y is the adjusted response and x duplicates height, both ignored.
Own Stan earnings_vary_si.stan (ARM Ch.13): log earnings with ethnicity-varying intercept and height slope. y is the adjusted response, x duplicates height, both ignored.
Own Stan earnings_vary_si_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of earnings_vary_si, same model (ARM Ch.13). y adjusted response, x duplicates height, both ignored.

formula: y ~ 1 + (1 + x | eth) + (1 + x | age) + (1 + x | eth:age)
notes: Own Stan earnings_latin_square.stan (ARM Ch.13 non-nested model): x is centred height, response y is adjusted log earnings. earn (raw) and height (duplicate of x) ignored. eth:age composite built by the merge from its parts.

formula: y ~ 1 + (1 + x | eth) + (1 + x | age) + (1 + x | eth:age)
notes: Own Stan earnings_latin_square_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of earnings_latin_square, same model (ARM Ch.13). earn and height (duplicate of x) ignored.
Own Stan pilots.stan (ARM Ch.13 non-nested varying intercepts): crossed group x scenario random intercepts. y is the recovery score per group-scenario cell (the aggregate behind pilots.dat).
Own Stan pilots_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of pilots, same crossed group x scenario model (ARM Ch.13).

Raw individual records behind pilots.data.json (301 obs over 5 groups x 8 scenarios); ARM fits the aggregated recovery rate with lmer (pilots.stan), so the raw binary outcome recovered is rendered as a crossed-random-intercept logistic model. RULE GAP: recovered carries NA entries, relying on the loader coercing NA to missing for the binary check.
ARM Ch.13 varying-slope radon (README radon_vary_si: lmer(y ~ 1 + (1 + x | county))); no own radon.stan. y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_inter_vary.stan (ARM Ch.13): county-level uranium u with a cross-level interaction u:x, varying slope and intercept on floor x by county. y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_inter_vary_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of radon_inter_vary, same model (ARM Ch.13). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_vary_si.stan (ARM Ch.13): varying slope and intercept on floor x by county. y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
Own Stan radon_vary_si_chr.stan: Matt-trick reparameterisation of radon_vary_si, same model (ARM Ch.13). y is log radon, raw radon ignored.
